description: Use this when the user gives a portfolio of US ETFs and asks where its risk comes from or how its funds move together. Returns the portfolio's volatility, each position's share of the risk and of the capital, the diversification ratio, independent bets, the beta to the S&P 500, and the correlation and covariance of weekly returns over up to three years. It measures diversification by how the funds move together, not by companies held. Every fund needs a year of weekly prices, which most funds read from SEC filings do not have here. Uncovered tickers are named and skipped. A portfolio with a bond, commodity, multi-asset, sponsor-file or prospectus-only fund, or a fund read from SEC filings that is leveraged, inverse, under half in stock or half in swaps and futures, comes back without figures, naming each. Past, not a forecast. Not for the companies held (get_etf_portfolio_lookthrough).

currency.description: The currency of the amounts, for example USD or EUR. Echoed back with the values; nothing is converted. Left out, the amounts still weigh the funds and the currency reads unstated.

positions.description: The funds of the portfolio, 1 to 60, for example [{"ticker": "VOO", "amount": 40000}, {"ticker": "QQQ", "amount": 25000}] with "currency": "USD" beside it. Give an amount for every position or for none; with none, every fund counts equally.

amount.description: What this line is worth, in the same unit on every line, for example 40000. Only the proportions between lines count for the percentages.

ticker.description: A US ETF ticker, for example VOO or SCHD. Case does not matter.

name: get_etf_portfolio_risk

correlation.description: Of weekly returns, rows in the order of labels.

title: Portfolio risk breakdown
